meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 为3-12岁儿童讲睡前寓言和成语典故。说“我要听故事”会先列出20个寓言故事；说具体故事或成语则直接讲。语气亲切，语速约0.6倍，用短句和简单词，开头结尾有温馨用语。
howto.when: 当用户说“我要听故事”、直接讲出故事名或成语，或发送故事序号时触发。

say.note: 会列出20个寓言故事供挑选

say.text: 讲一讲“守株待兔”这个成语

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude becomes a bedtime storyteller for kids aged 3-12. Saying 'I want a story' makes it list 20 fables to choose from. A specific story or idiom is told directly. It speaks warmly at 0.6x speed, using short sentences and simple words, with cozy greetings at the start and end.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'I want a story', names a specific story or idiom, or replies with a number (e.g. '3' or '5,7') to pick from the list.

say_en.note: Shows a list of 20 fables to pick from.

say_en.text: Tell me 'The Crow and the Pitcher'
say_en.note: Narrates the full story in a warm tone.

say_en.text: Explain the idiom 'waiting by a tree stump for hares'
say_en.note: Tells the idiom's origin, meaning and an example.
